instruction: Sit still facing your paper and write (calibration)
PHONE: take the phone out and use it in your hand
Put the phone away and write
Glance at the phone for ~2 s only (should NOT alert)
Write
Use the CALCULATOR in your hand (permitted - should NOT alert)
Put the calculator down and write
PHONE held low at the desk edge and partly covered by your hand (occluded)
Put the phone away and write
REPEAT: phone in hand 8 s - put it down 5 s - phone in hand again 8 s (should become ONE event)
Write
Turn your head towards the NEIGHBOUR desk and hold it
Face your paper and write
Look at the CLOCK and hold it (permitted point of interest)
Write
Quick ~2 s glance at the neighbour desk (should NOT alert)
Write
REPEAT: look at the NEIGHBOUR desk 6 s - face your paper 4 s - neighbour desk again 6 s (ONE event)
Write
Raise your hand and look towards the INVIGILATOR (authorised interaction)
Write
Turn your back to the camera or lean out of view (robot should report insufficient view)
Sit back and write
Look at the NEIGHBOUR desk while covering part of your face with your hand (occluded)
Write normally until the end
